autoIssue.heading: Auto-issue certificates
autoIssue.description: When enabled, learners receive a certificate as soon as their course completion crosses the threshold below.
autoIssue.thresholdHint: Learners receive a certificate once their course completion crosses this. Default 80; the server re-checks it at issuance.

numbering.badgeHintPart1: Stamped next to the certificate number, bottom-right — the design below shows you exactly where. To position it yourself instead, drag that badge, or drag the
numbering.badgeHintPart2: field onto the design. The same goes for the number: wherever you place
numbering.badgeHintPart3: , it stops being stamped automatically, so you never get two of either.
numbering.barcodeVerificationOption: Verification code — anyone can scan it to check the certificate
numbering.barcodeVerificationHintPart1: Scanning the barcode gives a code that verifies the certificate on your verification page. It carries about twice as much data as the number alone, so it needs to be at least
numbering.barcodeVerificationHintPart2: wide to still scan off a printed page — the design below warns you if it is too narrow.
numbering.barcodeNumberHint: Scanning gives the certificate number as text. That identifies the certificate but proves nothing, because the number on its own is not a credential. Switch to the verification code to make a barcode scan actually verify.
numbering.autoStampDescription: Printed bottom-right on certificates whose design does not place these itself. A field you place on the design always wins over the stamp.
numbering.stampCodeOnHint: Every certificate carries a scannable code.
numbering.stampCodeOffHint: Turned off — certificates with no code of their own cannot be verified by scanning.
numbering.stampNumberOnHint: Every certificate shows its number somewhere.
numbering.stampNumberOffHint: Turned off — the number is still allocated and still verifies, it is just not printed unless your design places it.
